d:
I travelled from Istanbul to Pamukkale. After a bus trip from Istanbul to Eskisehir, I took a train from Eskisehir to Denizli. The train, called Pamukkale Express, took 8 hours to reach the destination but passed through some of the best landscapes of rural Turkey. The train journey is cheaper and more comfortable than a bus trip between Eskisehir and Denizli. Watch this video to know many more reasons to take this train. This video is based on my trip to Turkey in late 2022.
